summary: A monthly subscription per fixed size, billed for the whole calendar month from order until cancellation; a powered-off server keeps its full bill.

egress.included: Unlimited traffic on every 2027 plan, at 500 Mbps on VPS-1 up to 3 Gbps on VPS-4
egress.note: OVHcloud advertises unlimited traffic with no per-GiB charge on the VPS pages, and publishes no overage rate or fair-use threshold for standard VPS. The bandwidth figure is the guaranteed minimum. Not priced by the calculator.

plans.name: Monthly, no commitment
plans.note: The card uses the no-commitment monthly price, which is also the ongoing renewal price. A 6-month commitment lowers it to $5.08 / $9.50 / $13.77 / $26.12; a 12-month commitment to $4.54 / $8.50 / $12.32 / $23.37, paid monthly. The product page's "Starting at" figures are the 12-month prices.

notes: Prices are OVHcloud's own USD list for the US subsidiary, read from its live public order catalog on 2026-10-30. They exclude sales tax: the catalog reports taxRate 0 and the US Terms of Service say all fees are exclusive of taxes.

OVHcloud sells whole months, not machine-hours. There is no hourly or per-second rate, so the calculator bills one plan per machine and lets short tasks share a plan: 1,000 ten-minute tasks need 166.67 hours and fit on one VPS-1.

Powering off is a power-off, not a pause: the subscription renews and the disk stays attached. The monthly plan therefore already covers stopped hours, and billedWhileStopped is not set (it would double-count).

VPS-1 has 2 vCores / 4 GB / 40 GB at $5.35, VPS-2 4 / 8 / 75 at $10.00, VPS-3 6 / 12 / 100 at $14.50 and VPS-4 8 / 24 / 200 at $27.50. OVHcloud quotes RAM and disk in GB; the card maps them 1:1 to the site's GiB fields. A/B/C asks are small enough that the difference does not change a shape.

The additional disk is sold in fixed sizes at fixed monthly prices — 50 GB $2.60, 100 GB $5.20, 200 GB $10.30, 500 GB $25.70, 1 TB $51.30, 5 TB $256.50, 10 TB $512.90 — not as a per-GiB rate. disk.extraMonthly would pro-rate sizes OVHcloud does not sell, so it is omitted and a request above the plan's own disk is reported as infeasible; the reader can still attach an additional disk, which this card does not price.

The order catalog lists a mandatory standard daily backup at $0.50 (VPS-1), $0.60 (VPS-2), $0.80 (VPS-3) and $1.20 (VPS-4) a month, but OVHcloud's configurator waives it: on the no-commitment VPS-1 order it shows "Automated Backup Standard - VPS-1 2027 $0.50 $0.00" and a total of $5.35 ex. taxes/month (read 2026-10-30). The product page also calls daily backups free, so the card leaves it out.

Optional monthly add-ons not priced by the card: snapshot from $0.40 (the catalog's 20 GB option is $1.20), premium 7-day backup $1.40–$5.90, additional IPs, Plesk and cPanel licences, and a Load Balancer.

Local Zone plans are priced separately: VPS-1 LZ is $6.54 monthly-billed and VPS-2 LZ $10.00. Local Zones also lose anti-DDoS, additional IPs, Windows, cPanel/Plesk/Docker images, load balancing and managed databases. Not modelled.
Snapshots and automated backups never include additional disks. A snapshot is one at a time and is deleted when restored.
The 2026 range (VPS-1 to VPS-6, plan codes vps-2025-model*) is still listed in the catalog but is not the range OVHcloud presents for new orders; it is not modelled.

cpuSharing.label: CPU sharing unpublished
cpuSharing.detail: OVHcloud publishes no CPU-sharing, burst or contention policy for its VPS vCores, so whether a core is shared is not stated.

upkeep.label: You run the server
upkeep.detail: OVHcloud makes the server's configuration, security and running your responsibility. A daily backup is included free.

source.quote: OVHcloud provides services for which you are responsible for their configuration and management. You are therefore responsible for their proper functioning.
